goal: Make Harness the durable owner of stable work context, executor attempts, media artifacts, revision lineage, and follow-up recovery without reopening terminal tasks.

acceptance_criteria.description: A stable work context binds the platform chat and subject across changing unified message origins without storing the full message body.
Harness records message references as metadata and a content digest instead of duplicating full conversation history.
Every executor attempt has a typed status and an idempotency key, and replaying the same start request returns the existing execution.
Successful execution settlement atomically records the artifact and terminal execution state without duplicating artifacts on callback replay.
A follow-up revision creates a child Harness task while the completed source task remains terminal and unchanged.
Artifact revisions preserve the original artifact and form a root, parent, and monotonic version chain.
Cancelling an active execution changes only execution and task state and never deletes completed artifacts or lineage.
After in-process image caches are cleared and the unified message origin changes, the Lark follow-up 人物再年轻一点 resolves the prior durable image artifact.
The Media adapter settles first generation and revision results through the shared Harness execution and artifact Interface.
A short revision-like message without a durable source artifact is not guessed as a media task.

non_goals: Do not make Harness the Router or scheduler.
Do not reopen terminal Harness tasks for revisions.
Do not duplicate complete conversation history in the work ledger.
Do not add employee permission resolution, long-term distillation, Obsidian publication, Codex settlement, or Hermes settlement in phase one.
Do not require a Dashboard redesign in phase one.
